chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Isḥāq ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā ibn Daryāb, who said:
I entered upon Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام after the passing of Abū Jaʿfar, so I offered him condolences over him, while Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام was sitting.
Then Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام wept, so Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام turned toward him and said to him: “Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has placed in you a successor from him, so praise Allah.”

key_terms.مُضِيِّ: passing away or departure through death

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate the succession of Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام after Abū Jaʿfar?
ai.summary: This narration describes a moment after the death of Abū Jaʿfar, when Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام consoled and addressed Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام. It indicates divine appointment and succession within the line of the Imams, while also showing grief, consolation, and gratitude to Allah.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Is’haq Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya Bin Daryaab who said,

‘I went over to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> (10<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) after the passing away of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> (9<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) So I consoled him<sup>asws</sup> about him<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) was seated.

So Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> wept and Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> faced him<sup>asws</sup> and said to him<sup>asws</sup>: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High has Made you<sup>asws</sup> to be a replacement from him<sup>asws</sup>, therefore Praise Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ishaq ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Daryab who has said the following.
“I went to see abu al-Hassan (a.s.) after the death of abu Ja‘far and offered condolences for this reason. Abu Muhammad (a.s.) was also present.
He wept and abu al-Hassan (a.s.) turned to him and said, “Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has made you to succeed (the Imam) instead of him. You must thanks Allah.”
